title: Beta Ali Akbar
body:
Basa Rehta Hai Nazron Me Tera Chehra Ali Akbar -2
Ye Madar Ab Tujhe Dundhe Kaha Beta Ali Akbar..
Basa rehtaa.....
Sine Ki Nook Me Uljha Hua Tera Kaleja Tha
Naa Jane Usko Kyse Baap Ne Dekha Ali Akbar
Basa........
Kahaa Hai Chand Mera Koi Toh Mujhko Khabar Dedo
Har Ek Tare Se Laila Ne Bohot Pucha Ali Akbar
Basa.......
Teri Awaz Toh Sunli Hai Budhe Baap Ne Lekin
Magar Binai Ne Usko Diyaa Dhokaa Ali Akbar
Basa.....
Kaha Madar Ne Ro Ro Kar Jawan Bete Ki Maiyyat Par
Mera Har Khuwab Tuta Tut Ke Bikhra Ali Akbar
Basa......
Zameen Thrraa Gai Aur Khoon Tapka Asmano Se
Sine Ko Ne Siney Jab Kechan Ali Albar
Basa .......
Nishan E Pak Tere Chum Ke Sughra Madiney Me
Kiya Krti Hai Tere Naam Pe Sajda Ali Akbar
Basa.....
Tamannaa Fatima Sughra Ki Puri Ho Nhi pai
Bandha Na Sar Pe Tere Haye Re Sehra Ali Akbar
Basa.....
Qalam Ko Ruk Lo Alyali Qirtas Par Likh Kar
Tumhara Aj Bhi Hai Muntazir Kaba Ali Akbar
